instruction: Enable the minimal view interface mode in VLC player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC minimal view mode via View > Minimal View (or Ctrl+H). Uses existing check_qt_minimal_view metric to verify the qt-minimal-view setting in vlcrc config file.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if qt-minimal-view is set to 1 in VLC config, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file from OS-specific path (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc on Linux)
Metric correctly parses the config file and checks qt-minimal-view setting
Expected value '1' is semantically correct for enabling minimal view mode
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies exactly what the instruction requires
